The molecular formulae of four organic compounds, W, X, Y and Z, are shown.
W
X
Y
Z
C3H8O
C3H6
C4H8O2

Which statement about compounds W, X, Y and Z is correct?
A
W and Z could both be alcohols.
B
Y is the only compound that could be a carboxylic acid.
C
W is a hydrocarbon.
D
X is ethene.

options.label: A
options.text: W and Z could both be alcohols.

options.label: B
options.text: Y is the only compound that could be a carboxylic acid.
